description: This Java class 'SensorSnifferPane' provides a GUI component for visualizing sensor data in real-time, including chart rendering, controls for pausing, clearing, saving images, and handling incoming data messages.

classes.name: SensorSnifferPane
classes.description: Main GUI component for sensor data visualization with controls and data processing.

classes.name: SensorSnifferCanvas
classes.description: Inner class responsible for rendering the sensor data chart.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state and updates the pause button label.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the data and resets min/max values.

methods.name: processValues
methods.description: Calculates min/max X and Y values from the data set.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Returns an ActionListener that focuses the command input when tab is selected.
